## Description and Rationale

We are a team with a strong background in enterprise software product engineering and aviation technology, with expertise in data science, Operational Research and Machine Learning Modeling. We are joining this challenge to apply predictive modeling to real operational flight data and learn from tackling a genuine aviation forecasting problem.

## Details

* Type: Academia, Industry, Independent
* Country: India
* Number of team members: 1
